snippet.title: Bug Drop Game Official Trailer - Survivor-like Top-Down Swam Shooter Roguelike
snippet.description: Fight through waves of alien bugs and bosses who have invaded Earth with characters with unique dash abilities, dozens of weapons and hundreds of abilities and skills. Level up and grab some gear and maybe you will survive the bug drop.  Look for the demo on Steam.  #indiegame #games #gameplay #actiongames #trailer
